title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance allowable rent increase
requirement: Landlords of RSO units may raise rent only once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage; from February 2, 2026 no additional utility increase and no increase for an added dependent is allowed.
coverage_conditions: Rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978, and replacement units; covers apartments, condominiums, townhomes, duplexes, ADUs, JADUs, hotel rooms occupied over 30 days, and mobile homes.

applicability.per_tenancy: In condominiums and townhomes the rent amount is not regulated for tenancies that commenced after December 31, 1995.
coverage_quotes: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

exemptions: Luxury exemption where the landlord establishes the monthly rent charged on or before May 31, 1978.
citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (L.A.M.C. §151.00 et seq.)
quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage

title: Los Angeles RSO legal reasons for eviction and relocation assistance
requirement: A landlord may evict an RSO tenant only for the listed at-fault or no-fault reasons; no-fault evictions require relocation assistance, and any termination notice must be filed with LAHD within three business days of service.
coverage_conditions: All rental units subject to the City's Rent Stabilization Ordinance.

coverage_quotes: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978

citation: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (L.A.M.C. §151.00 et seq.)
quoted_span: Give the tenant a 30-day and 60-day written notice (some evictions require 120-day notice or up to a 1-year extension).
